standfirst: The largest module in this build: 338 profiles over six features, covering 3,184 BV-BRC records. Replicase, a triple gene block (TGB1/2/3), coat protein, and a nucleic-acid-binding protein.

modules.Carlavirus: Split out of Quinvirinae on 24 September 2026 on measurement, not organisation. All six Quinvirinae genera share the replicase/TGB1-3/CP/NABP layout, so the organisation rule alone would have kept them together — but lumped, 25 references reach only 81.0%. Carlavirus has 102 clusters over 714 genomes at 6 kb and cannot spare a budget it shares; splitting improved every genus, Carlavirus itself gaining eleven points.

gaps: 171 source strings reached no collection. This page is reconstructed from the collections as shipped, so sequences dropped on length, ambiguity or a cleavage check count as unbound rather than as bound-then-filtered.
